name: Contraptions 23: road tips 2 (Momentum Bubbles 20)
description: A road network grown by solitons, tidier (Momentum Bubbles 20): one tip sets off east, laying road (the road reagent, the network) and, every road length, dropping a bud that hatches a new tip at right angles, to the side the side field says. A tip dies wherever it crosses a road running another way, so streets end in T-junctions instead of running into each other, and a bud too near old road (near) is spent without hatching, so blocks stop dividing once they're small and the map finishes. Paint side to choose which way branches go; near_max for the block size (higher, smaller blocks, but more tips run into each other); clock_rate for the road length.
